verdict.rationale: Choosing an entity type and jurisdiction is a fair question for a law firm that advises start-ups, so the axis applies. However, the evidence contains no published guidance comparing a Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, GmbH/UG or Indian Pvt Ltd. The Prarambh incubator's 'helping them set up' is a cohort programme rather than published guidance, and the blogs hub only names an India Corporate Law blog without showing any entity-choice content.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes guidance on choosing entity type and jurisdiction of incorporation (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd) appropriate to my market
